beats.text: The first computer bug was an actual insect.
beats.note: Engineers had been calling faults bugs for decades. This is the day one turned out to be literal.

beats.name: Harvard Mark II
beats.role: An operator traced a fault to a moth caught in a relay, removed it, and taped it into the logbook rather than throwing it away.

beats.line: The bug is still in the logbook.
